svg.title: Google Flow character video workflow
svg.desc: Manual Google Flow workflow with an optional no-extra-charge Wan Animate motion-transfer branch. Daniel clicks Generate and reviews each clip. Accepted free footage finishes locally without Flow regeneration. Flow fallback uses the best supported references in the EEA and does not guarantee exact source motion or lip sync.
